company_description:
Halden Pay is a fintech serving exporters with business accounts, foreign-exchange risk management and trade finance. Its work spans financial services, payments and international trade.

The company’s stated values are **Together, Ownership and Pace**: sharing information and helping across teams, taking responsibility and learning from mistakes, and reducing unnecessary complexity to move quickly for clients. Halden Pay describes its environment as collaborative, with hybrid working—typically three days a week in the office—and regular team events across its offices. It also offers career paths, an annual learning budget and mentoring.

Employee feedback describes colleagues as friendly and the culture as commercially driven, while noting that onboarding and training can vary between teams.

results.title: Halden Pay | Careers
results.content:
Growth and recognition
We offer clear career paths, a yearly learning budget and a mentoring programme in every department.
Our values: Together, Ownership, Pace
Together - we share context openly and help each other across teams.
Ownership - when something goes wrong we own it, fix it and learn from it.
Pace - we cut unnecessary complexity so we can move quickly for our clients.
How we work
Most of our offices work hybrid: people spend three days a week together in the office and the rest wherever suits them. Our engineering teams are organised in product areas: payments, risk, data platform and client experience. Team events and regular get-togethers are part of how we build connections across about 40 offices.
